analysis.title: FSA Fixed Income Daily Commentary - 18 November 2026
key_insights: US Treasury yields fell 1-3 bps across the curve on Tuesday on safe-haven demand as US equities fell for a fourth straight day. The 2Y yield fell 3 bps to 4.81% and the 10Y fell 2 bps to 5.11%.
Bunds rallied with Treasuries, led by shorter maturities, and the curve steepened slightly. Gilts diverged: the 10Y yield rose 0.5 bps and the 30Y rose 2.7 bps.

Fed speakers leaned hawkish. Williams said more work is needed on inflation but dismissed the need for an outsized hike, and said the Fed may need to raise rates more next year if growth drivers persist. Musalem said several hikes are likely before spring 2027, and Hammack favoured slow, steady increments.
Williams flagged the AI build-out as a potential persistent inflation driver and said tariff-related inflation effects had largely passed.

US struck an IRGC missile-launch site on Qeshm Island after Iran's third attack on Bahrain in under a week. Iran's Ghalibaf warned of retaliation against civilian infrastructure near US and Israeli bases, and there is no progress on the US naval blockade or Iran's nuclear programme.
October US data was mixed. Retail sales rose 0.2% m/m against 0.1% expected, import prices rose 1.1%, industrial production fell 0.4% against 0.1% expected, and the NAHB index fell to 25 from 29.
Global performance table: Nasdaq fell 2.49% on the day and 8.17% over 3 months, the S&P 500 fell 1.90% on the day, spot silver is down 34.42% YTD and spot gold down 11.53% YTD. WTI is up 50.33% YTD.
Recommendation changes: JD.com and Tencent Music moved to MP from UP, J&F moved to OP from MP, and Alstom moved to UP from MP.

JD.com 3Q26: revenue RMB309.6bn, up 3.5% YoY and 0.6% below consensus. Non-GAAP net income RMB8.33bn beat consensus of RMB8.1bn. Operating cash flow was an outflow of RMB18.7bn and net cash was RMB141.0bn. FSA views the results as credit neutral.

Tencent Music 3Q26: revenue RMB8.94bn, up 5.6% YoY and 2.2% below consensus. Non-IFRS net profit beat consensus. Gross debt rose to RMB21.8bn from RMB3.50bn at FY25 after USD1bn of notes issued in September, leaving net cash of RMB29.7bn. FSA sees better value in the 2036 notes.

Weibo 3Q26: revenue USD410m, down 7% YoY (13% in constant currency). Non-GAAP net income was USD14m against consensus of USD64m. Management says 2027 advertising growth is under pressure. FSA remains MP and sees WB 2030 as a carry play.

NVIDIA 3QFY27 revenue was USD115,844m, 6% above consensus, with non-GAAP EPS of USD2.68 against USD2.47 consensus. 4QFY27 revenue guidance is USD130.0bn plus or minus 3%, and the FY28 growth outlook was raised to about 75% from 70%. Gross margin eased to 74.8% from 75.0% QoQ and guidance is 71-72%.

NVIDIA disclosed that Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and director, with CFO Colette Kress interim CEO, and a board committee is investigating reported foreign intelligence targeting of him. Supply commitments rose to USD390bn from USD279bn.

Alstom 1H FY27: adjusted EBIT was a loss of EUR396m (margin -4.2%) after German project margin adjustments, free cash flow was an outflow of EUR1,248m, and net debt rose to EUR1,104m. Orders rose 5% and backlog is EUR111bn. FSA calls the results credit negative and is UP, with MP on the 5.868 perp NC 2029.

Accor will buy 44.3% of Ennismore for about EUR1.6bn in three tranches through January 2028, funded roughly one-third each by disposals, a credit facility and Accor shares. FSA views it as credit neutral and stays MP.

Lai Fung proposes a Shanghai REIT spin-off to repay a HKD2,467m loan due March 2027. Parents say they cannot sustainably provide liquidity and refinancing is not commercially feasible. FSA calls it credit negative, with cross-acceleration risk.
Country Garden reported a further RMB374m of overdue debt in the week to November 12th, RMB3.011bn since September 30th by FSA's calculation. FSA calls it credit negative and remains UP.

Nike's Investor Day set a 2031 framework with an operating margin of 12-14% by FY31. FY27 guidance for a high-single-digit revenue decline was kept, and leverage is expected to peak above 3x in FY28. FSA views it as credit neutral and stays MP.

Canadian Natural will buy Advantage Energy for CAD13.55 per share, with transaction value of about CAD2.53bn. Pro forma net debt of CAD14,647m would exceed the CAD13bn target. FSA views it as credit neutral and stays MP.

Israeli banks: Leumi's 3Q26 headline net income rose 10.6% but underlying profit rose only 1.6%, NIM narrowed to 2.06% and CET1 fell to 11.38%. Mizrahi's net profit fell 7.9% and CET1 is 10.10%. FSA stays MP on both and favours senior over subordinated debt at Mizrahi.
MBH Bank 9M26 adjusted PAT fell 26.8% YoY, NII fell 10.9%, NPLs rose to 3.8% and deposits fell. FSA stays MP and wants a meaningful spread premium to OTP.

J&F 3Q26 revenue rose 68.1% YoY but the adjusted EBITDA margin fell to 21.2% from 30.4%, and mining swung to an EBITDA loss. Net leverage was 2.42x and J&F agreed to sell Flora and Canal Rural to JBS for R$3.0bn. FSA upgraded to OP and describes itself as constructive but selective.
Imperial Brands FY26 adjusted EPS of 341p beat 334p expected, net leverage held at 2.0x and FY27 FCF guidance is at least £2.2bn. FSA stays OP and prefers EUR 33s/34s and USD 34s/35s.
Telecom Argentina 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA rose 12.5% and net leverage fell to 1.2x. Adjusted EPS beat consensus by about 20%. FSA stays MP because spread compression leaves limited upside.

Disney FQ4 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.77 beat the $1.68 consensus, boosted by a 53rd week. FY27 guidance is double-digit adjusted EPS growth ex-53rd week and about 8% segment operating income growth. FSA stays MP, citing rising sports rights costs and capital returns.
Saudi Energy 3Q26 revenue rose 12.874% to SAR35.0bn and 9M26 free cash flow was negative SAR38.8bn. A tariff adjustment is effective January 1st 2027 with no material impact expected. FSA stays MP.
Sammaan Capital 2QFY27 PAT was INR3.12bn, gross NPA fell to 0.15% and disbursements rose 62% QoQ. FSA stays OP.
Japan's October trade deficit was JPY476.5bn against JPY956bn expected. Exports rose 20.5% YoY, driven by AI-related electronic components and chip-making equipment.

market_movers.rationale: Moved to MP from UP on JD papers after mixed 3Q26 results. Liquidity of RMB214.7bn and net cash of RMB141.0bn offset the operating cash outflow and RMB13.4bn of current senior notes.
Moved to MP from UP following the recent spread widening. Gross debt rose sharply but net cash is RMB29.7bn. FSA sees better value in the 2036 notes.
Soft 3Q26 with advertising down, but liquidity exceeds gross debt. WB 2030 seen as a carry play.
Solid results with free cash flow of USD43,777m covering shareholder returns 1.6 times. FSA sees better value in the 2031 and 2033 tenors.
Alstom moved to UP from MP on an adjusted EBIT loss and higher net debt, except the 5.868 perp NC 2029 in EUR which stays MP.
J&F moved to OP from MP. Contracted energy earnings and liquidity support the credit, but mining weakness and dependence on JBS remain risks.
Country Garden stays UP on further overdue debt, defaulted borrowings of RMB82,396m and a going-concern uncertainty.
Imperial Brands stays OP on relative valuation and resilient free cash flow of £2.6bn.
Sammaan Capital stays OP with gross NPA at 0.15% and CRAR at 20.0%.
Investor Day framework is credit neutral, with leverage guided to peak above 3x in FY28.
Strong profitability in streaming and parks, offset by sports rights costs and capital returns.
Advantage Energy acquisition is credit neutral, though pro forma net debt of CAD14.6bn exceeds the CAD13bn target.

sector_views.rationale: JD, Tencent Music and Weibo are all MP after mixed to soft 3Q26 results, with net cash positions but softer revenue versus consensus.
Leumi and Mizrahi are MP. Strong franchises and efficiency are offset by narrowing capital buffers, margin pressure and geopolitical risk.
Country Garden stays UP with continued overdue debt, and Lai Sun's Lai Fung unit faces a loan maturity it cannot refinance.

earnings_insights: JD.com 3Q26 (reported 11/17): net revenues RMB309.6bn, 0.6% below consensus of RMB311.5bn. Non-GAAP net income to ordinary shareholders RMB8.33bn, above consensus of RMB8.1bn.
Tencent Music 3Q26 (reported 11/17): total revenues RMB8.94bn, 2.2% below consensus. Non-IFRS net profit attributable RMB2.45bn, above consensus of RMB2.36bn.
Weibo 3Q26 (reported 11/17): net revenues USD410m, 0.7% below consensus. Non-GAAP income from operations USD71m versus consensus USD72m. Non-GAAP net income USD14m versus consensus USD64m.

NVIDIA 3QFY27 (reported 11/17): revenue USD115,844m versus consensus USD109,481m. Non-GAAP operating income USD77,883m versus consensus USD71,899m. Non-GAAP EPS USD2.68 versus consensus USD2.47. 4QFY27 guidance is revenue USD130.0bn plus or minus 3% and gross margin 71.0-72.0%.

Alstom 1H FY27 (reported 11/17): sales EUR9,330m, adjusted EBIT loss of EUR396m, EBIT loss of EUR685m, Group-share net loss EUR954m. Management expects an adjusted EBIT margin of about 6.5% in the second half.
Disney FQ4 2026: adjusted EPS $1.77 against consensus $1.68, total revenue $25.95bn including an extra 53rd week. FY27 guidance is double-digit adjusted EPS growth ex-53rd week.
Imperial Brands FY26: adjusted operating profit £4.13bn versus £4.10bn expected, adjusted EPS 341p versus 334p expected. Volumes of 180.6bn sticks missed the 182.5bn forecast.
Telecom Argentina 3Q26: adjusted EPS USD0.308 versus USD0.256 expected, revenue of USD1.74bn broadly in line. A reported quarterly net loss of ARS57bn reflects an ARS384bn impairment.
Saudi Energy 3Q26 (reported 11/10): operating revenue 3.1% above consensus, operating profit 7.1% below consensus, net profit before Mudaraba holders 12.7% above consensus.
Bank Leumi 3Q26: net income NIS 2.99bn, up 10.6% YoY, helped by a deferred tax adjustment. Underlying profit rose 1.6% YoY to NIS 2.94bn.
Sammaan Capital 2QFY27 (reported 11/14): consolidated PAT INR3.12bn, up 28% QoQ and 1% YoY.
